_metadata.description: Quasi-identifier combination rules for linkage risk analysis
_metadata.legal_basis: DPDPA 2023 Section 2(t) — personal data includes data that identifies a person directly OR indirectly

rules.name: Government Identity Cluster
rules.description: Two government identifiers together create an extremely strong identity profile. Data minimisation principle under Section 6(1) requires justification for holding both simultaneously.
recommended_actions: Review whether both identifiers are necessary for the stated purpose — data minimisation violation likely
Ensure separate explicit consent was obtained for each identifier
Consider storing only one primary identifier and collecting the second only when legally required

rules.name: Financial Identity Profile
rules.description: Three financial identifiers together constitute a complete financial identity profile. This combination uniquely identifies an individual's financial accounts and enables full financial profiling.
recommended_actions: Verify explicit consent covers all three identifiers and their combined processing
Implement field-level encryption — these three together are highly sensitive
Apply strict access controls — limit who can query all three simultaneously
Review data minimisation — does the stated purpose require all three?

rules.name: Complete Contact Profile
rules.description: Name with email and phone number creates a complete contact profile enabling cross-channel identification and direct outreach. Raises consent and purpose limitation questions particularly for marketing use.
recommended_actions: Ensure consent was obtained for combined use of all three — not just individual collection
Do not use this combination for marketing without explicit marketing-specific consent
Apply data minimisation — which fields are actually necessary for the stated purpose?

rules.name: Government ID and Payment Cluster
rules.description: Aadhaar linked to a UPI payment handle creates a direct bridge between a person's national identity and their financial transactions. This combination enables complete financial behaviour profiling.
recommended_actions: Verify both identifiers are required for the same processing purpose
Implement strong encryption for this combination at rest and in transit
Ensure breach notification process covers this high-risk combination — Section 8(6)

rules.name: Payment Data Cluster
rules.description: Multiple payment method identifiers together create a critical financial data cluster. An individual's complete payment identity is exposed. PCI DSS obligations also apply independently of DPDPA.
recommended_actions: This combination requires immediate security review
Implement strongest available encryption for all payment identifiers
Verify PCI DSS compliance independently of DPDPA
Review whether both payment methods need to be stored simultaneously

rules.name: Full Government Identity Stack
rules.description: Three government identifiers for the same individual. No legitimate use case requires all three simultaneously for most business purposes. Almost certainly a data minimisation violation under Section 6(1).
recommended_actions: Review immediately — data minimisation violation highly likely
Determine which single identifier satisfies the legitimate purpose
Delete the excess identifiers — Section 8(7) requires deletion when purpose is served
Ensure consent was obtained for all three if retention is justified

rules.name: Identity and Vehicle Profile
rules.description: Name combined with driving licence and vehicle registration creates a physical-world identity profile linking a person to their physical presence and movement capability.
recommended_actions: Verify purpose justifies all three — data minimisation review required
Obtain explicit consent for combined processing
Limit access to this combination strictly

rules.name: Full Financial Stack
rules.description: All major financial identifiers present simultaneously. This combination constitutes a complete financial identity that enables access to all payment channels. Requires strongest safeguards.
recommended_actions: Immediate security review required
Verify PCI DSS compliance independently
Implement field-level encryption for every identifier in this combination
Restrict database queries that return all three simultaneously
Review data minimisation — no single business process requires all three

rules.name: Complete KYC Profile
rules.description: Three identity verification documents together create a comprehensive KYC profile. While KYC contexts may legitimately collect multiple documents, simultaneous storage of all three requires strong justification.
recommended_actions: Document which regulatory requirement mandates all three identifiers
Delete documents after KYC verification is complete — Section 8(7)
Ensure explicit consent covers all three
Implement strict access controls on this combination

rules.name: Person and Financial Identifier
rules.description: Name directly linked to PAN creates a named financial identity. This combination uniquely identifies a taxpayer and enables financial profiling by name.
recommended_actions: Ensure consent covers combined processing of name and PAN
Apply data minimisation — is the name required alongside PAN for this purpose?
Encrypt PAN — Section 8(4)
